All work. Endpoints tested with fake dataset — bigrams, letters, caps, emoji, search-by-author, context jump all correct.

**What changed:**

**Backend (`app.py`):**
- New `/api/users` — all authors + message counts
- `/api/search` — now takes `author` filter, returns newest-first, literal match (no regex injection)
- New `/api/funfacts?author=` — per-user or server-wide: top bigrams/trigrams/words/letters/emoji, message/word/char counts, avg words per msg, ALL-CAPS / question / exclaim counts, longest message, hour histogram, busiest day, favorite channels. URLs + mentions stripped, stopwords filtered, results cached per user.

**Frontend (full rewrite, orange HF theme 🤗):**
- **Top bar** — brand, three mode tabs (Discord / Search / Fun Facts), live msg/user count pills, dataset link
- **Discord mode** — server rail, categorized channel sidebar with collapse, message grouping (same author within 5 min), date dividers, hashed-color avatars, "load older" with scroll-position preservation, disabled fake input bar ("read-only archive 🔒"). No sending anywhere.
- **Search mode** — user dropdown (or all) + debounced live input (220ms), pulsing live dot, match count, every hit wrapped in glowing orange `<mark>`, stale-response guard, load-more pagination. Click result → jumps to Discord mode with full context, target message flash-highlighted.
- **Fun facts mode** — hero stat row (msgs, words, avg, favorite letter/word, busiest hour) + card grid: bigram/trigram/word/letter/emoji bar charts, 24-hour activity chart with peak highlight, personality stats, favorite channels, longest message blockquote.

Theme: warm dark browns with `#ff9d00`/`#ff6b00` gradients everywhere, orange scrollbars, glow effects, responsive down to mobile.

Run local: `HF_TOKEN=... uvicorn app:app --port 7860` in `hf_space/`.
